values.note: Campspot, October 2026: Rustic RV site (motorhomes allowed) $25 a night any night; 30/50-amp electric $45 weeknights, $55 Saturday; rustic waterfront $35 (offered to vans, trailers and fifth-wheels but not to motorhomes). Plus a $2 Reservation Surcharge and Campspot's $3 booking fee, each charged once per stay, and tax.

values.note: Book online through the operator's Campspot page ('Book Now' on campdeertrail.com) or call (231) 250-2051. Campspot refused one-night stays with 'There is a 2 night minimum over the requested period of time' on every date quoted (Tuesdays and Saturdays in October 2026); 2027 dates were not yet open to check whether summer differs. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 11 am.

note: Family-owned camp on 140 wooded acres along the east shore of Long Lake south of Harrison (6651 N Eberhart Ave), with half a mile of lakefront, three beaches, docks, canoes, kayaks and paddle boats and a private island; also cabins, a lodge and weddings/events. RV sites are rustic back-in sites, rustic waterfront (bluff) sites and newly built 30/50-amp electric sites; arrive with a full fresh-water tank. Not on RV Life; Campspot 4.7 over 31 verified reviews; Good Sam lists it unrated. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Campspot engine: base $25 (Rustic RV, motorhomes allowed) to $55 (30/50-amp Saturday), Oct 2026; 50-amp (confirmed), rigs to 40 ft (confirmed), 36 sites (29 RV + 7 tent), all back-in, no Wi-Fi, reservable on Campspot (confirmed; book URL added) with a 2-night minimum on every date quoted. Fees changed 35-45 -> 25-55 (the old $35 low was the rustic waterfront type, which Campspot does not offer to motorhomes). Phone (231) 250-2051 matches. Presence and price pass (working site with phone, booking engine, base well under US$50). Water/sewer/dump left as recorded (not stated on these pages). Note trimmed of prices and the 40-ft figure.
flags: Website: the second link is the Campspot marketplace page (campspot.com/park/camp-deer-trails-harrison-mi); the operator's own booking link, from 'Book Now' on campdeertrail.com, is https://www.campspot.com/book/campdeertrails.

Minimum stay: Campspot refused one-night stays on every October 2026 date quoted (Tue and Sat, 'There is a 2 night minimum over the requested period of time'), recorded as a standing 2-night minimum; 2027 dates were not open, so a summer rule could not be checked.

Motorhome type: Campspot's 'Rustic waterfront' sites (7, to 30 ft) list Van, trailers and fifth-wheels but not Motorhome; the Rustic ($25) and 30/50 Amp sites do list Motorhome, so the base is the Rustic type.

Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator offers 'Rustic Lakefront Campsites' ('Amenities: Lakefront') and 'a half mile of lakefront access'; the entry has 'not waterfront' (the lakefront RV sites are the rustic waterfront type above).
Pin: the park record on Campspot puts the operator at 44.084285,-84.748482, about 1 km ESE of the entry's 44.08717,-84.76024; worth checking the pin against imagery.
Seasonal character (not a fail): the sites page says 'Set up camp for the night or the season!', but nightly booking is open on all 29 RV sites, so the long-stay tests do not bite.
